public.text: The requirement again uses “pseudo-anonymised.” In addition, generating pseudonymous identifiers within the Client Registry may create a central linkability service whose misuse could enable broad surveillance.
public.suggestedRevision: Use “pseudonymised” and require strict separation, access controls, purpose-specific pseudonyms, authorised linkage processes, key governance, and re-identification safeguards.
